subject: general
question: The ratio of the ages of A, B and C, 5 years ago, was 4 : 5 : 7. The sum of their present ages is 135 years. What will be the sum of the ages (in years) of B and C, 3 years from now?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of ages of A, B, and C 5 years ago = Present sum − (3 persons × 5 years) = 135 − 15 = 120.

Total ratio parts 5 years ago = 4 + 5 + 7 = 16 parts.

Value of 1 ratio part = 120 ÷ 16 = 7.5 years.

Sum of ages of B and C 5 years ago = (5 + 7) parts = 12 × 7.5 = 90 years.

Sum of B and C 3 years from now = Sum 5 years ago + (5 years + 3 years) × 2 persons = 90 + 16 = 106 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 106 years.**
